node.statement: By def-maincb-partition-state, k and j being in the same equivalence class means dim S^A_{P_k,P_j}=1 for every k in U. The remaining geometric hypotheses required by lem-maincb-stage2-extcb-datum are exactly the assumed nonempty U, j notin U, R=U union {j}, and the one-dimensional atomic images P_j.
